identity.name: 🔬 Einstein-v4-7B
identity.summary: A full fine-tuned version of Mistral-7B-v0.1 on diverse datasets.

links.citation: The model card thanks the dataset authors mentioned in its datasets section.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card states training on 'diverse datasets' but gives no dataset names, sources, or usage terms, so provenance is uncertain.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card lacks documentation of how the 'diverse datasets' were collected, curated, or used, limiting explanation of model behavior.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only architecture, base model, and training setup, with no evaluation results or design/development details.

possible_risks.description: Improper usage occurs when a model is used for a purpose that it was not originally designed for.
possible_risks.justification: Open-weight full fine-tune of Mistral-7B-v0.1 with no reported evaluations or intended-use restrictions could be used for purposes it was not designed for.

training_context.adaptations: The model is a full fine-tune of mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1, trained for 1.5 epochs using axolotl on 7xRTX3090 + 1xRTXA6000.
